tagline.en: The border road, from the Bronx to the Canadian line
tagline.zh: 沿州界而行的路，自布朗克斯至加拿大边境

end.zh: 克林顿县穆尔斯的 US 11

en: NY 22 does one thing: it follows the eastern edge of New York State. From US 1 in the Bronx it runs north past Mount Vernon and White Plains, through the horse country and reservoir land of the New York City watershed, then up the line of the Taconic and Berkshire hills with Connecticut, Massachusetts and Vermont a few miles to the right the whole way.

Almost all of it is a two-lane rural road through villages and hamlets — Pawling, Millerton, Hoosick Falls, Cambridge, Salem, Granville, Whitehall, Ticonderoga, Port Henry, Keeseville. The exceptions are the built-up southern end in the Bronx and lower Westchester and a stretch through the city of Plattsburgh near the top.

North of Whitehall it enters the Adirondack Park and runs along Lake Champlain, which is the most memorable part of the route and also the emptiest: forest on the left, water and Vermont on the right, and a string of very small places between the ferry landings.
zh: NY 22 只做一件事：沿着纽约州的东缘走。自布朗克斯的 US 1 起，它向北经过芒特弗农与白原，穿过纽约市水源地的马场与水库地带，随后沿塔科尼克与伯克希尔丘陵一线北上，全程右手几英里外便是康涅狄格、马萨诸塞与佛蒙特。
它几乎整条都是穿行村镇的双车道乡道——波灵、米勒顿、胡西克福尔斯、剑桥、塞勒姆、格兰维尔、怀特霍尔、提康德罗加、亨利港、基斯维尔。例外是布朗克斯与下威斯特彻斯特的建成区南端，以及接近北端时穿过普拉茨堡市的一段。
怀特霍尔以北，它进入阿迪朗达克公园，沿尚普兰湖而行；这是全线最难忘、也最空旷的一段：左手是森林，右手是湖水与佛蒙特，渡口之间散落着一串极小的聚落。

en: The route has been shrinking at both ends. At the southern end NY 22 once ran down into lower Manhattan by way of Fourth Avenue, Park Avenue, 110th Street, Lenox Avenue, 145th Street, the Grand Concourse, Jerome Avenue, East 233rd Street and Provost Avenue; in 1972 the designation was cut back to its present end near the Bronx–Westchester line.
At the northern end it once continued to the Canadian border near Mooers. In 2008 that was truncated by about three and three-quarter miles to the junction with US 11, which is where it ends now.

The Lake Champlain corridor it follows is older than any of this. The New York Highway Law's description of the Lakes to Locks Passage traces a route from the Waterford–Cohoes bridge north along Route 32, US 4 and NY 22 through Whitehall, Ticonderoga, Crown Point, Westport and Keeseville to Plattsburgh and the border — essentially the colonial and military road between the Hudson and the St Lawrence.
zh: 这条路线两端都在收缩。南端的 NY 22 曾经沿第四大道、公园大道、110 街、莱诺克斯大道、145 街、大广场路、杰罗姆大道、东 233 街与普罗沃斯特大道一路通入下曼哈顿；1972 年，该编号被缩回至今天布朗克斯与威斯特彻斯特交界附近的端点。
北端它曾一直通到穆尔斯附近的加拿大边境。2008 年，这一段被截短约三又四分之三英里，终于与 US 11 的交汇处，也就是今天的终点。
它所沿行的尚普兰湖走廊，比这一切都古老。纽约公路法对「湖闸通道」的描述，勾勒出一条自沃特福德—科霍斯桥向北，沿 32 号公路、US 4 与 NY 22 经怀特霍尔、提康德罗加、克朗波因特、韦斯特波特与基斯维尔通往普拉茨堡与边境的路线——本质上就是哈德逊河与圣劳伦斯河之间的殖民时期与军用道路。

en: The Champlain section is a designated All-American Road. NYSDOT lists the Lakes to Locks Passage as 190 miles connecting Waterford and Rouses Point; the Federal Highway Administration's byway entry, which includes the Quebec continuation, gives 234 miles and suggests two to five days for the New York portion alone.

What the byway is actually about is water. It follows the interconnected line of the Upper Hudson, the Champlain Canal, Lake George, Lake Champlain, the Richelieu River and the Chambly Canal — the corridor that was fought over through the French and Indian War, the War for Independence and the War of 1812, and that carried commercial traffic long after.

Practically: ferries cross to Vermont at several points, the villages are small enough that services close early, and the two-lane road through the park is the sort where a slow truck sets the pace for twenty minutes at a time.
zh: 尚普兰路段是一条指定的「全美道路」。纽约州交通部将湖闸通道列为连接沃特福德与鲁塞斯波因特的 190 英里路线；联邦公路管理局的风景道条目将魁北克延伸段计入，给出 234 英里，并建议仅纽约段就安排二至五天。
这条风景道真正的主题是水。它沿着上哈德逊河、尚普兰运河、乔治湖、尚普兰湖、黎塞留河与尚布利运河这条互连的水线而行——这条走廊在法国印第安战争、独立战争与 1812 年战争中反复易手，此后长期承载商业运输。
实务上：多处可乘渡轮前往佛蒙特；村镇规模小到店铺打烊很早；穿越公园的双车道路上，一辆慢车往往一次就决定二十分钟的行车节奏。

why.en: NYSDOT publishes highway mileage by jurisdiction and county rather than by touring route, and no state-published total for NY 22 could be verified this session.
why.zh: 纽约州交通部按管辖主体与县发布公路里程，而非按巡游路线；本次未能查证到该州公布的 NY 22 总里程。

timeline.en: The southern terminus is cut back from lower Manhattan to the Bronx–Westchester line.
timeline.zh: 南端点自下曼哈顿退回布朗克斯与威斯特彻斯特交界。

timeline.en: The northern terminus is truncated from the Canadian border to US 11 at Mooers.
timeline.zh: 北端点自加拿大边境截短至穆尔斯的 US 11。
